I will buy one bag of NPK from the market to spread on this my plot, and I will plant the improved seed I got from the agro-dealer because it gives better cobs than the local one. I will also buy herbicide to control the weeds since my back is not strong anymore, but I will not irrigate because we depend on the rains here in the North West. My wife and I will work this plot for about 35 days over the season, and I will hire two young men for 5 days when the harvest is heavy.
